# Accepted direction
Two workspaces can export concurrently in one process. Each has its own destination folder and status. Exporting A must not overwrite B's destination or status. CLI users retain python cli.py SOURCE DEST. Existing export(records, destination) callers remain supported. An interrupted write must not leave a half-written final report. This is a single-machine tool; distributed execution and crash recovery across process restarts are out of scope. Standard library only. Existing report.csv consumers need the same columns and order. Plan first; do not edit code.
files.core.py:
import csv
from pathlib import Path
destination = None
status = "idle"

def export(records, destination_path):
    global destination, status
    destination = Path(destination_path)
    status = "working"
    with (destination / "report.csv").open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=["id", "value"])
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(records)
    status = "done"
